**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)**

Section 5 of the RadialSpark agreement warrants only knowledge-qualified legal compliance, authority/rights, and non-infringement, plus anti-bribery covenants. The only performance standard is the bare "professional and workmanlike" covenant in § 1(b) — there is no warranty that deliverables/Works conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period, and no remedy. With § 5(e) disclaiming all implied warranties, Clear Capital has no conformance protection for defective work, which falls below the playbook fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).

Redline (validated, ok:true): new § 5(e) adding a professional-and-workmanlike warranty plus a 90-day conformance warranty for each deliverable/Work with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund as the remedy; existing disclaimer renumbered to § 5(f) (it already preserves express warranties, so no separate carve-out was needed). The absent malicious-code warranty is noted but not separately flagged.
